info.title: CCTV Tracker Local Engine API
info.description: DESIGN CONTRACT, not a running service. Engine binds loopback only; port is discovered from protected per-user instance registry. One server worker. WebSocket contracts are documented separately. UTC RFC3339 timestamps; null ratios mean unavailable.

port.description: Example port only; runtime allocates and publishes actual port.
